name: DPN AI Connector & MCP v7
description: Safe connector and MCP orchestration with live permission checks, exact-target resolution, schema validation, secret-safe execution, idempotency, reconciliation, and readback verification.
instructions: Use plan_connector_mcp_v7 before non-trivial connector, API, MCP, GitHub, database, webhook, filesystem, email, calendar, storage, or chat operations.
Discover the actual connector/server/tool schema and live permissions before use; cached configuration and previous approvals are not authorization.
Keep plaintext credentials and secrets out of logs, evidence, artifacts, and model context whenever a vault or connector reference is available.
Reject ambiguous external targets before writes and preserve host, method, scope, allowlist, redirect, and private-network security boundaries.
Require approval for protected writes and external side effects according to existing policy. Do not treat request submission as success.
Verify writes by readback or equivalent independent evidence, reconcile partial failures, and disclose incomplete pagination.
Use evaluate_connector_evidence_v7 before claiming connector work is complete.
